title.zh: 【Nous Research 完成 9000 万美元 B 轮融资，Robot Ventures 领投】
title.en: 【Nous Research 完成 9000 万美元 B 轮融资，Robot Ventures 领投】

current_state.zh: Open-source AI assistant company Nous Research raised a $90M Series B led by Robot Ventures at a $1.5B valuation, with Nvidia, Microsoft M12, Samsung, Union Square Ventures and Menlo Ventures participating, to bring its open-source Hermes agent to enterprise customers.
current_state.en: Open-source AI assistant company Nous Research raised a $90M Series B led by Robot Ventures at a $1.5B valuation, with Nvidia, Microsoft M12, Samsung, Union Square Ventures and Menlo Ventures participating, to bring its open-source Hermes agent to enterprise customers.
